sents.en: Bees are insects.
Ants, beetles, and butterflies are insects too.
Bees live in many places.
You can even find them in your backyard.
sents.ko: 우리 집 뒤뜰에서도 볼 수 있어요.

sents.en: Many bees have black and yellow stripes.
sents.ko: 많은 벌은 검은색과 노란색 줄무늬가 있어요.

sents.en: Some bees are hairy!
Bees have three main body parts.
They are the head, thorax, and the abdomen.
Bees have six legs and four wings.
sents.ko: 벌은 다리가 여섯 개, 날개가 네 개예요.

sents.en: They have five eyes and two antennae.
sents.ko: 눈은 다섯 개, 더듬이는 두 개예요.

sents.en: Bees have a special mouthpart.
It looks like a straw.
Ouch! Watch out! All female bees have stingers.
sents.ko: 아! 조심하세요! 암컷 벌은 모두 침이 있어요.

sents.en: Some bees live alone.
Other bees live in large groups called colonies.
sents.ko: 어떤 벌은 군집이라는 큰 무리를 이루어 살아요.

sents.en: Colonies live in nests or beehives.
Bees carry pollen from flower to flower.
Some bees produce honey for us to eat.
sents.ko: 어떤 벌은 우리가 먹을 꿀을 만들어요.

sents.en: Wow! Bees have five eyes.
I didn't know that.
But, I knew that bees make really yummy honey.
sents.ko: 그런데 벌이 아주 맛있는 꿀을 만드는 건 알고 있었어요.

sents.en: This book taught us a lot about bees.
sents.ko: 이 책은 벌에 대해 많이 알려 줬어요.

sents.en: I'll see you next time! Good-bye!
